content:
# Optional project-local R packages; ignored in the browser's virtual filesystem.
if (dir.exists("../.r-library")) .libPaths(c(normalizePath("../.r-library"), .libPaths()))
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
source("lib/statistics.R", local = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
source("lib/plots.R", local = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")

# Native MathML keeps the course formulas available offline.
math <- function(body) {
  body <- gsub('<mo>([()|])</mo>', '<mo stretchy="false">\\1</mo>', body)
  HTML(paste0('<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block">', body, '</math>'))
}
si <- '<msub><mi>s</mi><mi>i</mi></msub>'
tn <- '<msub><mi>T</mi><mi>n</mi></msub>'
sum_n <- '<munderover><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></munderover>'


svg_output <- function(id, height) {
  tags$div(class = "svg-plot", `data-plot` = id,
           style = paste0("height:", height, "px"), uiOutput(id))
}

normal_frame <- tags$section(class = "frame",
      tags$div(class = "population-controls",
        radioButtons("population", "总体分布（中位数均为 0）",
          choices = setNames(names(population_labels), unname(population_labels)),
          selected = "normal", inline = TRUE)),
      tags$div(class = "figure",
        tags$div(class = "figure-heading", textOutput("sample_size", inline = TRUE),
                 tags$span("重复模拟 10,000 次")),
        svg_output("distribution", 260),
        tags$div(class = "legend",
                 tags$span(class = "legend-hist", "模拟分布"),
                 tags$span(class = "legend-normal", "标准正态 N(0,1)"))
      ),
      tags$aside(class = "formulas",
        uiOutput("normal_assumption"),
        math(paste0('<mrow>', si, '<mo>=</mo><msup><mi>Φ</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup>',
          '<mo>(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>R</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow>',
          '<mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>)</mo>',
          '<mi mathvariant="normal">sgn</mi><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>i</mi></msub>',
          '<mo>−</mo><msub><mi>M</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow>')),
        math(paste0('<mrow>', tn, '<mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow>', sum_n, si,
          '</mrow><msqrt><mrow>', sum_n, '<msubsup><mi>s</mi><mi>i</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup>',
          '</mrow></msqrt></mfrac></mrow>')),
        tags$p(class = "limit-condition", "连续、对称的零假设下："),
        math(paste0('<mrow>', tn, '<mover><mo>→</mo><mi>d</mi></mover>',
          '<mi>N</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo>',
          '<mspace width="1em"/><mi>n</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>∞</mo></mrow>')),
        tags$p(class = "rank-note", "Rᵢ 为 |Xᵢ − M₀| 的秩")
      ),
      tags$div(class = "controls",
        sliderInput("n", "样本量 n", min = 3, max = 200, value = 3, step = 1, ticks = FALSE),
        actionButton("play", "播放"), actionButton("reset", "重置")),
      tags$div(class = "diagnostics",
        tags$section(
          tags$h3("正态 Q–Q 图"),
          tags$p("点越接近橙色直线，正态近似越好。"),
          svg_output("qq", 205)),
        tags$section(
          tags$h3("三种总体的密度"),
          tags$p("蓝色实线为所选总体；其余为灰色虚线。"),
          svg_output("score_mapping", 205))
      ),
      tags$p(class = "mechanism", tags$strong("数据产生："),
             textOutput("normal_mechanism", inline = TRUE)),
      tags$p(class = "comparison-note", textOutput("normal_comparison", inline = TRUE))
)

sign_frame <- tags$section(class = "frame",
  tags$div(class = "population-controls",
    radioButtons("sign_population", "总体分布（中位数均为 0）",
      choices = setNames(names(population_labels), unname(population_labels)),
      selected = "normal", inline = TRUE)),
  tags$div(class = "figure",
    tags$div(class = "figure-heading", textOutput("sign_sample_size", inline = TRUE),
             tags$span("单样本 · 重复模拟 5,000 次")),
    svg_output("sign_distribution", 260),
    tags$div(class = "legend", tags$span(class = "legend-hist", "模拟分布"),
             tags$span(class = "legend-normal", textOutput("sign_reference", inline = TRUE)))),
  tags$aside(class = "formulas",
    tags$p(class = "assumption", "H₀：中位数 M = M₀ = 0；无需对称性。"),
    math('<mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>=</mo><munderover><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></munderover><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>></mo><msub><mi>M</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow>'),
    math('<mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>∼</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Bin</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>)</mo></mrow>'),
    math('<mrow><mi>Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><msqrt><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msqrt></mfrac><mover><mo>→</mo><mi>d</mi></mover><mi>N</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow>'),
    tags$p(class = "rank-note", "观测独立、总体连续；S 为正差值个数。"),
    tags$p(class = "rank-note", "按钮可切换精确分布与正态近似。")),
  tags$div(class = "controls",
    sliderInput("sign_n", "样本量 n", min = 3, max = 200, value = 3, ticks = FALSE),
    actionButton("sign_method", "切换到精确二项分布"),
    actionButton("sign_play", "播放"), actionButton("sign_reset", "重置")),
  tags$div(class = "diagnostics",
    tags$section(tags$h3("累计分布对比"),
      tags$p("蓝色为模拟累计分布；橙色为所选参考分布。"),
      svg_output("sign_cdf", 205)),
    tags$section(tags$h3("一次样本的正负号"),
      tags$p("只计正负号，不使用观测大小与秩。"),
      svg_output("sign_sample", 205))),
  tags$p(class = "ks-summary", textOutput("sign_summary", inline = TRUE)),
  tags$p(class = "mechanism", tags$strong("数据产生："),
           textOutput("sign_mechanism", inline = TRUE)),
  tags$p(class = "comparison-note",
    "三个总体均满足 H₀，符号个数的精确零假设分布相同；卡方减去中位数后虽仍偏态，也适用符号检验。")
)

ks_frame <- tags$section(class = "frame ks-frame",
  tags$div(class = "figure",
    tags$div(class = "figure-heading", textOutput("ks_sample_size", inline = TRUE),
             tags$span("一次样本的经验分布")),
    svg_output("ks_ecdf", 280),
    tags$p(class = "gap-note", "紫色线段标出最大差距 Dₙ；空心点表示跳跃前的左极限。")
  ),
  tags$aside(class = "formulas",
    tags$p(class = "assumption", "H₀：F = F₀ = Φ"),
    math(paste0('<mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo>',
      '<mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>n</mi></mfrac>', sum_n,
      '<mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>≤</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow>')),
    math('<mrow><msub><mi>D</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><munder><mi mathvariant="normal">sup</mi><mi>x</mi></munder><mo>|</mo><msub><mi>F</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>F</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>|</mo></mrow>'),
    math('<mrow><msqrt><mi>n</mi></msqrt><msub><mi>D</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mover><mo>→</mo><mi>d</mi></mover><mi>Z</mi><mo>∼</mo><mi>K</mi><mspace width="0.6em"/><mi>n</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>∞</mo></mrow>'),
    tags$div(class = "limit-formula", math(paste0(
      '<mrow><mi>K</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>z</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn>',
      '<munderover><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>∞</mo></munderover>',
      '<msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup>',
      '<msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>k</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msup></mrow>'))),
    tags$p(class = "rank-note", "K 为 Kolmogorov 分布函数（z > 0）。F₀ 的参数预先指定。")
  ),
  tags$div(class = "controls",
    sliderInput("ks_n", "样本量 n", min = 3, max = 500, value = 3, step = 1, ticks = FALSE),
    actionButton("ks_play", "播放"), actionButton("ks_reset", "重置")),
  tags$div(class = "diagnostics",
    tags$section(
      tags$h3("√n Dₙ 的抽样分布"),
      tags$p("蓝色：重复模拟 5,000 次；橙色：Kolmogorov 极限密度。"),
      svg_output("ks_distribution", 220)),
    tags$section(
      tags$h3("累计分布与极限分布"),
      tags$p("蓝色：模拟累计分布；橙色：K(z)。"),
      svg_output("ks_cdf", 220))
  ),
  tags$p(class = "ks-summary", textOutput("ks_summary", inline = TRUE)),
  tags$p(class = "mechanism", tags$strong("数据产生："),
    "独立生成 Xᵢ ~ N(0,1)，与预先指定的 F₀ = Φ 比较。上图依次加入同一序列的观测；下方每次独立抽取 n 个观测计算 Dₙ，重复 5,000 次。")
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$title("非参数检验演示"),
            tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "styles.css"),
            tags$script(src = "plot-resize.js")),
  tags$main(class = "demo",
    tabsetPanel(id = "page",
      tabPanel("正态计分检验", value = "normal",
               tags$h1("正态计分检验的渐近正态性"), normal_frame),
      tabPanel("符号检验", value = "sign",
               tags$h1("符号检验：中位数"), sign_frame),
      tabPanel("经验分布与 KS 检验", value = "ks",
               tags$h1("经验分布与 Kolmogorov–Smirnov 检验"), ks_frame)
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  experiment <- reactive({
    req(input$n)
    population <- if (is.null(input$population)) "normal" else input$population
    req(population %in% names(population_labels))
    key <- paste0(population, "_", input$n)
    if (!exists(key, cache, inherits = FALSE))
      assign(key, simulate_experiment(input$n, population = population), cache)
    get(key, cache, inherits = FALSE)
  })
  values <- reactive(experiment()$statistics)
  sign_experiment <- reactive({
    req(input$sign_n, input$sign_population)
    key <- paste("sign", input$sign_population, input$sign_n, sep = "_")
    if (!exists(key, cache, inherits = FALSE))
      assign(key, simulate_sign_experiment(input$sign_n, input$sign_population), cache)
    get(key, cache, inherits = FALSE)
  })
  ks_experiment <- reactive({
    req(input$ks_n)
    key <- paste0("ks_", input$ks_n)
    if (!exists(key, cache, inherits = FALSE))
      assign(key, simulate_ks_experiment(input$ks_n), cache)
    get(key, cache, inherits = FALSE)
  })
  svg_renderer <- function(plot_function, id, height, default_width) {
    renderUI({
      width <- input[[paste0(id, "_width")]]
      if (is.null(width)) width <- default_width
      HTML(plot_svg(plot_function(), width = width, height = height))
    })
  }
  output$sample_size <- renderText(paste0("n = ", input$n))
  output$distribution <- svg_renderer(function() normal_score_plot(values()), "distribution", 260, 650)
  output$qq <- svg_renderer(function() normal_qq_plot(values()), "qq", 205, 460)
  output$score_mapping <- svg_renderer(function() population_comparison_plot(experiment()$population), "score_mapping", 205, 460)
  output$normal_mechanism <- renderText({
    run <- experiment()
    generating <- if (run$population == "chisq")
      sprintf("独立生成 Yᵢ ~ χ²(3)，取 Xᵢ = Yᵢ − %.3f，使中位数 M₀ = 0；", chisq_median)
    else paste0("每次从", population_labels[[run$population]], "独立抽取 n 个观测（中位数 M₀ = 0）；")
    paste0(generating, "按 |Xᵢ| 排秩、恢复符号，再计算 Tₙ；重复 10,000 次得到抽样分布。")
  })
  output$normal_assumption <- renderUI({
    population <- experiment()$population
    if (population == "chisq")
      tags$p(class = "assumption skew-note", "中位数 = 0，但不对称；下方正态近似条件不成立。")
    else tags$p(class = "assumption", "总体连续、对称；H₀：中位数 M₀ = 0")
  })
  output$normal_comparison <- renderText({
    run <- experiment()
    if (run$population == "chisq")
      sprintf("偏态对照：中位数为 0 不能保证 Tₙ 的标准正态近似。本次模拟 Tₙ 均值 %.2f、标准差 %.2f。", mean(run$statistics), sd(run$statistics))
    else "正态与柯西均连续、关于 0 对称，Tₙ 的零假设分布相同；柯西总体无有限均值和方差，仍可进行这个秩检验。"
  })
  output$ks_sample_size <- renderText(paste0("n = ", input$ks_n))
  sign_mode <- reactiveVal("normal")
  observeEvent(input$sign_method, {
    sign_mode(if (sign_mode() == "normal") "exact" else "normal")
  })
  observe({ updateActionButton(session, "sign_method", label =
    if (sign_mode() == "normal") "切换到精确二项分布" else "切换到正态近似") })
  output$sign_sample_size <- renderText(paste0("n = ", input$sign_n))
  output$sign_reference <- renderText(if (sign_mode() == "normal")
    "正态近似 N(0,1)" else "精确二项分布 Bin(n, 1/2)")
  output$sign_distribution <- svg_renderer(function()
    sign_distribution_plot(sign_experiment(), sign_mode()), "sign_distribution", 260, 650)
  output$sign_cdf <- svg_renderer(function()
    sign_cdf_plot(sign_experiment(), sign_mode()), "sign_cdf", 205, 460)
  output$sign_sample <- svg_renderer(function()
    sign_sample_plot(sign_experiment()), "sign_sample", 205, 460)
  output$sign_summary <- renderText({
    run <- sign_experiment()
    d <- run$details
    exact <- sign_mode() == "exact"
    p <- if (exact) run$p_exact else run$p_normal
    sprintf("本次样本：正号 S = %d，负号 = %d；%s = %.4f；按 p < 0.05 的模拟拒绝比例：%.1f%%。",
      d$S, d$n-d$S, if (exact) "精确 p" else "正态近似 p（连续性校正）",
      p[1], 100*mean(p < 0.05))
  })
  output$sign_mechanism <- renderText({
    run <- sign_experiment()
    base <- switch(run$population, normal = "Xᵢ ~ N(0,1)（中位数为 0）；",
      cauchy = "Xᵢ ~ C(0,1)（中位数为 0）；",
      chisq = sprintf("Yᵢ ~ χ²(3)，取 Xᵢ = Yᵢ − %.3f（减去理论中位数，使中位数为 0）；", chisq_median))
    paste0("独立生成 ", base,
      "统计 Xᵢ > 0 的个数 S，重复 5,000 次。切换参考分布使用同一批样本。")
  })
  output$ks_ecdf <- svg_renderer(function() ks_ecdf_plot(ks_experiment()), "ks_ecdf", 280, 650)
  output$ks_distribution <- svg_renderer(function() ks_distribution_plot(ks_experiment()), "ks_distribution", 220, 460)
  output$ks_cdf <- svg_renderer(function() ks_cdf_plot(ks_experiment()), "ks_cdf", 220, 460)
  output$ks_summary <- renderText({
    run <- ks_experiment()
    sprintf("本次样本：Dₙ = %.3f，√n Dₙ = %.3f；渐近 p 值 = %.3f（小样本近似）。",
            run$details$D, sqrt(run$n)*run$details$D, run$p_asymptotic)
  })

  playing <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  sign_playing <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  ks_playing <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  animate_panel <- function(prefix, nodes, playing) {
    n_id <- paste0(prefix, "n")
    play_id <- paste0(prefix, "play")
    reset_id <- paste0(prefix, "reset")
    last_step <- reactiveVal(0)
    observeEvent(input[[reset_id]], {
      playing(FALSE)
      updateSliderInput(session, n_id, value = nodes[1])
    })
    observeEvent(input[[play_id]], {
      if (playing()) playing(FALSE)
      else {
        if (input[[n_id]] >= max(nodes)) updateSliderInput(session, n_id, value = nodes[1])
        last_step(as.numeric(Sys.time()))
        playing(TRUE)
      }
    })
    observe({ updateActionButton(session, play_id, label = if (playing()) "暂停" else "播放") })
    observe({
      req(playing())
      invalidateLater(2000, session)
      isolate({
        if (as.numeric(Sys.time()) - last_step() >= 1.9) {
          next_n <- nodes[nodes > input[[n_id]]]
          if (!length(next_n)) playing(FALSE)
          else updateSliderInput(session, n_id, value = next_n[1])
          last_step(as.numeric(Sys.time()))
        }
      })
    })
  }
  animate_panel("", c(3L, 5L, 10L, 20L, 50L, 100L, 200L), playing)
  animate_panel("sign_", c(3L, 5L, 10L, 20L, 50L, 100L, 200L), sign_playing)
  animate_panel("ks_", c(3L, 5L, 10L, 20L, 50L, 100L, 200L, 500L), ks_playing)
  observeEvent(input$population, { playing(FALSE) })
  observeEvent(input$sign_population, { sign_playing(FALSE) })
  observeEvent(input$page, {
    if (input$page != "normal") playing(FALSE)
    if (input$page != "sign") sign_playing(FALSE)
    if (input$page != "ks") ks_playing(FALSE)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: lib/plots.R
content:
plot_font_family <- function() {
  available <- unique(systemfonts::system_fonts()$family)
  preferred <- c("Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Micro Hei")
  found <- preferred[preferred %in% available]
  if (length(found)) found[1] else "sans"
}

demo_theme <- function(size = 13) {
  family <- plot_font_family()
  theme_minimal(base_size = size, base_family = family) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#EDF0F3", linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.title = element_text(colour = "#465B6B"),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 14, 5, 8))
}

# SVG keeps Chinese as UTF-8 text; the viewing browser resolves CJK fonts.
# Do not fix textLength using webR's non-CJK fallback font measurements.
plot_svg <- function(plot, width = 650, height = 260) {
  device <- svglite::svgstring(width = max(280, width) / 96, height = height / 96,
                              bg = "white", fix_text_size = FALSE)
  device_id <- grDevices::dev.cur()
  on.exit({
    if (device_id %in% grDevices::dev.list()) grDevices::dev.off(device_id)
  }, add = TRUE)
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off(device_id)
  svg <- device()
  families <- "'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'WenQuanYi Micro Hei', sans-serif"
  svg <- gsub("font-family:[^;]+;", paste0("font-family: ", families, ";"), svg)
  svg <- sub("<\\?xml[^>]*\\?>", "", svg)
  enc2utf8(svg)
}

normal_score_plot <- function(z, statistic_label = expression(T[n])) {
  bounds <- c(min(-4, floor(min(z))), max(4, ceiling(max(z))))
  reference <- data.frame(x = seq(bounds[1], bounds[2], length.out = 601))
  reference$y <- dnorm(reference$x)
  ggplot(data.frame(T = z), aes(T)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0.125,
                   fill = "#638FA9", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = reference, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              colour = "#D9863B", linewidth = 1.25) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = bounds, ylim = c(0, 1.15)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 7)) +
    labs(x = statistic_label, y = "概率密度") +
    demo_theme(14)
}

normal_qq_plot <- function(z) {
  dat <- data.frame(theoretical = qnorm(ppoints(length(z))), observed = sort(z))
  bounds <- c(min(-4, floor(min(z))), max(4, ceiling(max(z))))
  ggplot(dat, aes(theoretical, observed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "#D9863B", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(colour = "#638FA9", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.25) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4, 4), ylim = bounds) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)) +
    labs(x = "标准正态分位数", y = "统计量分位数") + demo_theme()
}

score_mapping_plot <- function(experiment) {
  n <- experiment$n
  curve <- data.frame(r = rep(seq_len(n), 2),
                      score = c(normal_scores(n), -normal_scores(n)))
  curve$branch <- rep(c("positive", "negative"), each = n)
  ggplot(experiment$sample, aes(r, score)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#CFD9E0", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = curve, aes(group = branch), colour = "#BAC7D0",
              linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = sign), size = if (n > 50) 1.5 else 2.6, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("正差值" = "#638FA9", "负差值" = "#9B789F"), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = if (n <= 5) seq_len(n) else scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)) +
    labs(x = "绝对值的秩 Rᵢ", y = "正态记分 sᵢ") +
    demo_theme() + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
                         legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

population_comparison_plot <- function(population) {
  x <- sort(unique(c(seq(-4, 8, length.out = 1001), -chisq_median)))
  dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(population_labels), function(name) {
    data.frame(x = x, density = population_density(x, name), population = name)
  }))
  dat$population <- factor(dat$population, levels = names(population_labels))
  colours <- setNames(rep("#BDC7CF", 3), names(population_labels))
  colours[population] <- "#638FA9"
  types <- setNames(rep("dashed", 3), names(population_labels))
  types[population] <- "solid"
  # Draw the selected density last so it remains visible at crossings.
  dat <- rbind(dat[dat$population != population, ], dat[dat$population == population, ])
  ggplot(dat, aes(x, density, colour = population, linetype = population)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.95) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colours, labels = c("正态", "柯西", "居中卡方")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = types, labels = c("正态", "柯西", "居中卡方")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4, 0, 4, 8)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4, 8), ylim = c(0, 0.45)) +
    labs(x = "原始观测值 x", y = "总体密度", colour = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    demo_theme(12) + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
                           legend.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.key.width = grid::unit(14, "pt"))
}

sign_distribution_plot <- function(experiment, method = "normal") {
  n <- experiment$n
  k <- 0:n
  probability <- tabulate(experiment$S+1, nbins = n+1)/experiment$B
  if (method == "exact") {
    dat <- data.frame(x = k, y = probability, reference = dbinom(k, n, 0.5))
    bounds <- range(c(experiment$S, floor(n/2-4*sqrt(n/4)), ceiling(n/2+4*sqrt(n/4))))
    bounds <- c(max(0, bounds[1]), min(n, bounds[2]))
    ggplot(dat, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#638FA9", width = 0.7) +
      geom_point(aes(y = reference), colour = "#D9863B", size = 1.9) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = bounds+c(-0.6, 0.6)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
      labs(x = "正号个数 S", y = "概率") + demo_theme(14)
  } else {
    step <- 1/sqrt(n/4)
    dat <- data.frame(x = (k-n/2)/sqrt(n/4), y = probability/step)
    reference <- data.frame(x = seq(-5, 5, length.out = 601))
    reference$y <- dnorm(reference$x)
    ggplot(dat, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#638FA9", width = step, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
      geom_line(data = reference, aes(x, y), colour = "#D9863B", linewidth = 1.15) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = range(c(-4, 4, experiment$statistics))) +
      labs(x = "标准化正号个数 Z", y = "概率密度") + demo_theme(14)
  }
}

sign_cdf_plot <- function(experiment, method = "normal") {
  n <- experiment$n
  k <- 0:n
  observed <- cumsum(tabulate(experiment$S+1, nbins = n+1)/experiment$B)
  if (method == "exact") {
    dat <- data.frame(x = c(-1, k, n+1), y = c(0, observed, 1),
                       reference = c(0, pbinom(k, n, 0.5), 1))
    bounds <- c(max(-1, floor(n/2-4*sqrt(n/4))), min(n+1, ceiling(n/2+4*sqrt(n/4))))
    ggplot(dat, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_step(colour = "#638FA9", linewidth = 0.95) +
      geom_step(aes(y = reference), colour = "#D9863B", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = bounds, ylim = c(0, 1)) +
      labs(x = "正号个数 S", y = "累计概率") + demo_theme()
  } else {
    dat <- data.frame(x = (c(-1, k, n+1)-n/2)/sqrt(n/4), y = c(0, observed, 1))
    reference <- data.frame(x = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 601))
    reference$y <- pnorm(reference$x)
    ggplot(dat, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_step(colour = "#638FA9", linewidth = 0.95) +
      geom_line(data = reference, aes(x, y), colour = "#D9863B", linewidth = 0.95) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4, 4), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
      labs(x = "标准化正号个数 Z", y = "累计概率") + demo_theme()
  }
}

sign_sample_plot <- function(experiment) {
  d <- experiment$details
  dat <- data.frame(sign = factor(c("负号", "正号"), levels = c("负号", "正号")),
                    count = c(d$n-d$S, d$S))
  ggplot(dat, aes(sign, count, fill = sign)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.45) +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, colour = "#465B6B", family = plot_font_family()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("负号" = "#9B789F", "正号" = "#638FA9"), guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(dat$count)*1.2), breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "观测个数") + demo_theme()
}

ks_ecdf_plot <- function(experiment) {
  x <- sort(experiment$sample)
  n <- experiment$n
  bounds <- range(c(-3.5, 3.5, x)) + c(-0.15, 0.15)
  steps <- data.frame(x = c(bounds[1], x, bounds[2]),
                      y = c(0, seq_len(n)/n, 1))
  theory <- data.frame(x = seq(bounds[1], bounds[2], length.out = 700))
  theory$y <- pnorm(theory$x)
  gap <- experiment$details
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = theory, aes(x, y, colour = "理论分布 F₀"), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_step(data = steps, aes(x, y, colour = "经验分布 Fₙ"), linewidth = 0.9) +
    annotate("segment", x = gap$x, xend = gap$x,
             y = gap$theoretical, yend = gap$empirical,
             colour = "#9B789F", linewidth = 1.6) +
    annotate("point", x = gap$x, y = gap$empirical, shape = 21,
             fill = if (gap$left_limit) "white" else "#9B789F",
             colour = "#9B789F", size = 2) +
    annotate("text", x = gap$x, y = (gap$theoretical + gap$empirical)/2,
             label = sprintf("Dₙ = %.3f", gap$D), hjust = -0.15,
             colour = "#8E6893", size = 3.8, family = plot_font_family()) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("经验分布 Fₙ" = "#638FA9", "理论分布 F₀" = "#D9863B")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = bounds, ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "观测值 x", y = "累计概率") + demo_theme() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

ks_distribution_plot <- function(experiment) {
  reference <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 2.6, length.out = 601))
  reference$y <- kolmogorov_density(reference$x)
  ggplot(data.frame(z = experiment$statistics), aes(z)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.075, boundary = 0,
                   fill = "#638FA9", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = reference, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              colour = "#D9863B", linewidth = 1.1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2.5), ylim = c(0, 2.3)) +
    labs(x = "缩放统计量 √n Dₙ", y = "概率密度") + demo_theme()
}

ks_cdf_plot <- function(experiment) {
  z <- sort(experiment$statistics)
  steps <- data.frame(x = c(0, z, max(2.6, z)), y = c(0, seq_along(z)/length(z), 1))
  reference <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 2.6, length.out = 601))
  reference$y <- kolmogorov_cdf(reference$x)
  ggplot() +
    geom_step(data = steps, aes(x, y), colour = "#638FA9", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(data = reference, aes(x, y), colour = "#D9863B", linewidth = 1.1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2.5), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "缩放统计量 √n Dₙ", y = "累计概率") + demo_theme()
}
